plains.name: Plains
plains.description: Open grassland. Easy to flee, hard to hide.

road.name: Road
road.description: Cracked asphalt. Move fast, be seen.

ruins.name: Ruins
ruins.description: Collapsed structures. Loot inside the rubble.

house.name: House
house.description: Suburban home. Boards on the windows.

supermarket.name: Supermarket
supermarket.description: Empty shelves... mostly. Worth checking the back.

hospital.name: Hospital
hospital.description: Medical supplies. Bodies that won't stay down.

military.name: Military Outpost
military.description: Fortified, fortified, fortified. Guns, if you're lucky.

gas_station.name: Gas Station
gas_station.description: Fuel and snacks. The pumps still spark.

church.name: Church
church.description: Stone walls. People hid here. They're still here.

junkyard.name: Junkyard
junkyard.description: Towers of rusted metal. Scrap heaven, structural disaster.

police_station.name: Police Station
police_station.description: Cells. A locker room. The armory's been picked over, but not cleaned out.

farm.name: Farm
farm.description: Overgrown fields. Old tools. Some plants still know how to grow.
